topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I found out that my child has Mr. Thompson as their teacher, a wave of mixed feelings washed over me. I remember those days, how his strictness often overshadowed his good intentions. I can only hope that the years have softened him, made him a bit more understanding. It's not that I think my child can't handle a firm hand, but I can't help wondering if they might judge me through him, as I did my father through his tough lessons. I wish I could have prepared my child better, maybe even apologized for my part in the past. Now, I just stand here, wishing things could be different, for their sake.
